description: This file defines an interface for payment authorization providers within a payment processing system. It specifies methods for retrieving the provider information and authorizing payments using authorization attempts.

classes.name: PaymentAuthorizationProvider
classes.description: Interface for payment authorization providers, establishing a contract for authorization operations and provider identification.

methods.name: provider
methods.description: Returns the payment provider associated with this authorization provider.

methods.name: authorize
methods.description: Performs authorization of a payment based on the provided authorization attempt.
